questions.q: Jude calls himself a servant of Jesus Christ and the brother of whom?
What reason does Jude give for urging readers to contend for the faith?
options: Ungodly men had crept in secretly
The apostles had been put in prison

questions.q: What did Michael the archangel say while arguing with the devil about Moses' body?
Which three are named in Jude's woe against these men?
Contend earnestly for the faith which was ____ delivered to the saints.
Autumn trees without fruit, twice dead, ____.
Enoch, ____, prophesied, saying, "Behold, the Lord came with ten thousands of his holy ones."

items: A people saved out of Egypt, unbelievers destroyed
Sodom and Gomorrah suffering eternal fire
Michael contending about the body of Moses

questions.q: Jude reminds readers that the apostles foretold mockers would come in the last time.
Jude says he was first eager to write about the coming judgment before changing his subject.
